feature_definitions.gamma_site_density: Protein heavy atoms within 6 A of the nucleotide gamma split by ligand chain, acceptor chain, and other chains; no titles or labels are used.
feature_definitions.hydroxyl_anchor_to_gamma_angle_degrees: Angle at the candidate hydroxyl between the hydroxyl-to-anchor vector (Ser/Thr CB or Tyr CZ) and the hydroxyl-to-gamma vector.
feature_definitions.hydroxyl_halfspace_counts: Protein heavy atoms within 6 A of the hydroxyl split into gamma-facing and backside half-spaces along the hydroxyl-to-gamma axis.
feature_definitions.orientation_support_class: Frozen descriptive class: gamma_facing_active_site_like when the hydroxyl anchor angle is 70-170 degrees, at least 4 other-chain heavy atoms are gamma-facing within 6 A, and at least 8 ligand-chain protein heavy atoms occupy the catalytic gamma site within 6 A; orientation_unsupported when angle <45 or no other-chain atom is gamma-facing; otherwise intermediate.

hypothesis: If substrate-role identity is encoded by source-free active-site geometry, then true acceptor hydroxyls should show a gamma-facing sidechain orientation and asymmetric catalytic-chain density that recovers folded Tyr positives while rejecting topology-confounded mimics such as 9UW4.

blocker_classification.classification: Active-site orientation/asymmetry is review-only context; it does not establish source-free substrate-role identity on the frozen diagnostic set.

false_negative_analysis.interpretation: Remaining misses are expected where no terminal gamma-equivalent is resolved, where same-chain/autophosphorylation-like topology dominates, or where folded reciprocal context is not encoded by a general frozen orientation class.

false_positive_analysis.interpretation: The orientation probe is accepted only as a frozen feature-family test. Any scalar split learned from the hard trio is marked post-hoc and not used for prediction.

run_record.hypothesis: Source-free active-site orientation/asymmetry features can distinguish true folded Tyr substrate acceptors from topology-confounded mimics if structure-only substrate-role identity is recoverable.
run_record.next_query: Classify the remaining strict-rule false negatives by unavailable ligand state versus same-chain/autophosphorylation-like topology, then decide whether the lane should stop feature probing and preserve a source-reviewed adjudication requirement for ePK substrate-role identity.
run_record.recommendation: Do not claim ePK production readiness. Keep active-site orientation features as review-only ambiguity evidence and require hybrid source-reviewed adjudication for folded reciprocal or product/analog cases.
